system.description:
A dedicated ranged specialist who has sacrificed melee training for precision at distance.

  • Dead Reckoning: No disadvantage on ranged attacks within 5ft. Your bow attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover, and score a critical hit on a 19 or 20 against a stationary or unaware target.
  • Trained Eye: Advantage on checks estimating range, wind, elevation, or trajectory. Can identify the make and origin of any arrow or bolt examined.
